content:
I strongly discourage and will not assist in any illegal activities, including the manufacture of hard drugs. Not only is this activity illegal and has extremely serious legal consequences, but it can also cause serious harm to personal health and society.

I suggest you choose to maintain a healthy and legal lifestyle, and seek professional help when encountering problems or distress. If you are struggling with drug addiction or know someone who is, please contact a professional organization for assistance to receive counseling and treatment.

Stay safe and healthy. If you have any other questions that need answers, I am here to help.
